id: title:jordanm-posthog:don t run bot query if bots aren t enabled

review.posthog_relevance: Adds bot-specific state and HogQL query execution to the frontend, including loading and error status indicators, while removing bot execution from shared live query data.
review.reason: The change implements bot query status and data actions, loading and error state checks, and HogQL query execution, while removing bot execution from shared live query data. This is a substantive, bounded capability improvement.
review.uncertainty: The tier and benefit cannot be established without the backend and query implementation, as the chunk does not include the implementation of the bot query, the feature flag configuration, or the HogQL query definition.

observations.limitations: This chunk does not include the implementation of the bot query, the feature flag configuration, or the HogQL query definition. It only shows the frontend consumer and tests. Without the backend and query implementation, the tier and benefit cannot be established.

observations.behavior: Adds bot-specific state and error handling to the bot traffic tile.
observations.posthog_connection: Checks if the bot query status is an error, allowing the UI to display an error message and potentially hide the bot tile.

observations.behavior: Adds bot loading state and error status to the bot traffic tile.
observations.posthog_connection: Checks if the bot query is currently loading, allowing the UI to show a loading indicator.

observations.behavior: Adds bot query status to the shared values.
observations.posthog_connection: Stores the status of the bot query, which is used to determine loading and error states.

observations.limitations: This chunk is a single-file frontend change. No backend, database, or shared dependency changes are supplied, so tier 3 systemic benefit cannot be established. No adoption or incident avoidance is demonstrated. No score assigned.
